correctness.rationale: PASS: For each nonempty proper S, the centered two-level state theta_i=((N−m)/N)d for i in S and −(m/N)d otherwise satisfies F(theta)=omega exactly because d=K sin d has a unique 0<d<pi solution for each K>1. Positive-index labels distinguish 2^N−2 lifts plus zero on the torus; all collapse as K→1+. The Jacobian has global eigenvalue 1, relative-mode 1−K cos d>0, and transverse eigenvalues 1−K[t+(1−t)cos d] (m−1 times) and 1−K[(1−t)+t cos d] (N−m−1 times), omitting zero multiplicities. Singular conditions belong to q(d) at m/N or 1−m/N. q(d) is nonconstant real analytic on a compact extension of (0,pi), q(0)=2/3−d²/90+..., so each of finitely many fractions has finitely many roots and cannot accumulate at K=1. Local inverse charts give open target persistence outside E_N. No claim of exact entire fiber. Numerical direct phase-map residuals were <1e−10 for N=2,5,7 and K=1.05,1.7,2.3; these tests are not the all-N proof.
